kinds.name: bmi
kinds.title: Height, weight and BMI
kinds.description: Height and weight with their units; the BMI is calculated and written with them.

kinds.name: bodyMap
kinds.title: Body map
kinds.description: Mark findings on a picture of the body, face, eye or teeth: tap a region (each can write its own sentence), drop pins with a short label, or tap fixed markers that open follow-up questions.

says.sentence: pain in the forehead, severity {value} out of 10

kinds.name: choice
kinds.title: Choice
kinds.description: Pick one option from a short list (sex, side, severity). Each option can carry its own sentence and follow-up questions.

kinds.name: date
kinds.title: Date
kinds.description: A calendar date (date of birth, onset, last visit). Written as dd/mm/yyyy. Set purpose to 'birth' for a date of birth: a template can then say {{key.age}} (for example '42 years' or '8 months') or {{key.years}}.

kinds.name: drawing
kinds.title: Drawing
kinds.description: A sketch drawn with a pen or finger on a blank sheet or on a body, face, eye or tooth chart, with a few words about it. Tapping a part of the chart marks it and can write its own sentence.

sketch.description: Lesion on the dorsum of the hand.

kinds.name: duration
kinds.title: Duration
kinds.description: How long something has lasted: a number and a unit (days, weeks, months, years), a range such as 5-7 days, or a time of day.

kinds.name: eyeDiagram
kinds.title: Eye diagram
kinds.description: A paired right-eye / left-eye chart: either the eight eye-movement positions marked full or restricted, or four labelled boxes around each eye for readings. Can be left out of the printout.

kinds.name: grid
kinds.title: Grid
kinds.description: Rows and columns of small fields (text, number, choice, yes/no) for a chart or table: tap a cell to fill it, or use a Quick Fill chip such as All normal. Prints as a table (with merged header, row and cell spans) and/or reads as sentences.

kinds.name: measure
kinds.title: Measurement
kinds.description: A single reading with a unit, entered on a big stepper or slider (weight, blood pressure, pain score).

kinds.name: multi
kinds.title: Multiple choice
kinds.description: Pick any number of options (complaints, triggers). Options can have follow-up questions such as side and duration; unticked options can be written as negative history.

kinds.name: number
kinds.title: Number
kinds.description: A number: age, a count, a reading. Optional unit label and limits.

kinds.name: photoMarkup
kinds.title: Photo with markup
kinds.description: One photo taken or chosen on the spot, marked up with a pen, pins and short labels (a wound, a rash, a swelling), with a few words about it.

wound.description: Wound on the left shin, day 5.

kinds.name: photos
kinds.title: Photos
kinds.description: A few photos taken or chosen on the spot, each with a short description and optional pen or pin markup. Printed as a grid with the descriptions as captions.

kinds.name: pictureChoice
kinds.title: Picture choice
kinds.description: Pictures laid out in a box (a hand, a leg, a tooth): the doctor taps the ones that apply and they light up. A set of picks like Multiple choice, or one pick when multiple is off. Each part is an option with a place in the box, a picture and its own words; any combination of parts can have its own sentence (says.combinations).

examples.name: with a sentence for a combination

kinds.name: repeat
kinds.title: Repeating group
kinds.description: A group of fields the doctor can add again and again (each ulcer, each scar). Writes one small section per repetition from a template using {{childKey}}, {{index}} and {{groupLabel}}.

kinds.name: repeatPages
kinds.title: Repeating pages
kinds.description: Repeats one or more whole pages as many times as needed (each pregnancy, each operation). Writes one section per repetition using the page's own narrative.

kinds.name: size
kinds.title: Size
kinds.description: A size with one to five dimensions and a unit (a swelling of 2 x 3 cm).

kinds.name: text
kinds.title: Text
kinds.description: Free text the doctor types or dictates: a name, an address, a note. Can be a phone number or an e-mail address.

kinds.name: yesno
kinds.title: Yes / No
kinds.description: A yes/no question, optionally with Not applicable. Each answer can write its own sentence and ask follow-up questions. Can also be a single tick box (says.whenTrue / whenFalse).
